name: Atalanta BC (Gasperini era, 2016-2025)
scopeNote: Atalanta BC under Gian Piero Gasperini, nine seasons 2016/17 to 2024/25. Start = first competitive match, Coppa Italia third round v Cremonese 3-0 at Bergamo, 13 Aug 2016 (Serie A opener was 21 Aug 2016, 3-4 v Lazio; appointment 2016-06-14 is not a match date). End = last Serie A match of 2024/25, Atalanta 2-3 Parma on 25 May 2025 (date and score only from a search summary and a betting preview, not yet read on a page). Sources call the style a 3-4-3 / 3-4-2-1 / 3-4-1-2 back-three system with an aggressive man-oriented (man-to-man) press; Football Manager-style 'gegenpress' or 'zonal' labels would be wrong, zonal assignments appear only in the mid/low block. 2015/16 (Reja) and 2025/26 (Juric) are outside the period. Verified evidence is strongest for 2018/19, 2019/20 and the 2023/24 Europa League final; 2016/17 to 2017/18, 2020/21 to 2022/23 and 2024/25 are thin.
openQuestions: Last match date 2025-05-25 (Atalanta 2-3 Parma) is from a search summary and a Betfred preview URL, not a read page.

Chiesa di Totti (Jan 2026) quotes Glenn Crooks saying Gasperini 'has remained true to his man-marking tactics throughout his coaching career' but is about Roma 2025/26 (outside period), so not used as verified evidence.
Gomez-Gasperini dressing-room row at half-time v Midtjylland (Dec 2020) and Gomez's exit (Jan 2021) only seen in search summaries (Goal, Football Italia, Fanpage); not mined.

Evolution of the marking over nine years (2016/17-2018/19 Gomez as 10 in 3-4-1-2/3-4-3; 2020/21 post-Gomez 3-4-2-1; 2021-24 Koopmeiners, Lookman, Retegui) lacks dedicated 2016/17 and 2021-23 tactical sources; Mastermind pieces (2020, 2021) returned 403.

Sale figures (Kessie EUR 28m, Gagliardini ~EUR 22m, Conti EUR 24m, Caldara EUR 25m, Retegui EUR 65m, Hojlund, Koopmeiners) seen only in search summaries from Calcio e Finanza/Soccerway; Sport360 (2017) verifies Gagliardini EUR 28m and Caldara EUR 25m.

Gap pass: no usable tactical source found for 2017/18 (Europa League) and nothing contemporary for 2016/17 beyond earlier entries plus a 2023 Goal.com retrospective (retrospectiveOnly); 2021/22 evidence is only an early-season (Sept 2021) TFA report. Marking evolution: TFA Oct 2022 says man-to-man remains a principle but is not used for a whole match; 2019 Left Back Football shows man-oriented to zonal switch in the 5-3-2; no source charts it year by year.
Gomez exit month (Jan 2021) now verified by Forza Italian Football (Jun 2021) but the Midtjylland row remains unread.
